evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.909 Torr before growth at approximately 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure rose progressively during growth from 2.979 Torr at 2520 s to 3.249 Torr despite approximately constant Ar flow; no expected pressure range is supplied.
Temperature 749.8 C and Ar 99.6 sccm closely match setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm; controller reports running, but these do not verify atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: Required exhaust O2 measurement, expected growth-pressure range and investigation of the pressure rise are needed to verify execution and distinguish possible leak or exhaust restriction; sample characterization is not yet available.
